statement: On 5 + 8 Z_2 there is no square root (all branches).
argument: An odd square is 1 mod 8: (2k + 1)^2 = 4 k (k + 1) + 1 and k (k + 1) is even. So no point of 5 + 8 Z_2 is a square, and a failed existence criterion on the whole ball is DOMAIN (tools/adf/README.md:509). Child of b5.
